verdict.rationale: Muse explicitly supports linking email, calendar, and other services with user-controlled permissions and approval cards, and can build custom connectors for other APIs, which covers email/calendar well. However, cloud drive (e.g., Google Drive/Dropbox) connectivity is never mentioned, and there's no evidence of search/retrieval quality across these sources being used in answers beyond general assistant framing. missing for 10: explicit cloud-drive/file-storage connector support, evidence of search-and-cite behavior pulling from connected email/calendar/drive in answers, independent verification of connector reliability.
